purpose: Teach: 待望/見慣れ/あいにく/小麦/大まか/風習/嘆き/気まぐれ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、待望の遠足、明日よ
lines.en: Sho, your big field trip is tomorrow.
lines.style: Warm, gently building excitement. Bright opening. Slow enough for him to feel included. A mother's delight in having something to look forward to.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、見慣れたお祖父ちゃんちが、一番落ち着くよ
lines.en: Mom, I feel most calm at Grandpa's house — the one I always know.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. No hesitation. Eyes focused somewhere safe. The steady voice of a child who has found his anchor. Small and genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、あいにく今日は雨予報よ
lines.en: Sho, unfortunately the forecast says rain tomorrow.
lines.style: Gentle letdown delivered without drama. A slight pause before the news. Measured pace. Her practical mind already shifting to what this means for plans.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小麦アレルギーのお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, I already talked to Dad about the wheat allergy thing.
lines.style: Small pride in his own careful planning. Speaking to the practical part of her he understands. Quiet competence. No seeking reassurance — reporting something handled.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのご予定、大まかに聞いたわ
lines.en: Sho, I've already asked Grandpa roughly what he has planned.
lines.style: Practical efficiency. Quick, assured. The mother who thinks ahead and manages details without fuss. A slight nod in her voice — box checked.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祭りの風習、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm really looking forward to the festival traditions.
lines.style: Genuine brightness breaking through. His voice lifts on 楽しみ. Small boy rediscovering something he loves about these visits. Eager but not loud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「嘆きの壁」のお話してたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about the Wailing Wall.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. She's sharing something she finds interesting. A small smile in her voice at the memory of him explaining it. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんは気まぐれな性格って、笑ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was laughing about how his personality is kind of unpredictable.
lines.style: Dry, knowing edge. A small laugh just underneath. He's noticed something about his father and found it funny rather than frustrating. Adult-adjacent observation from a six-year-old. Wry but not unkind.
